repair.diagnosis: The fixed Add to Cart button is occluded by the fixed sticky-promo bar, making it unclickable at all viewports.
repair.evidenceSummary: Probes at mobile, small, and desktop show add-to-cart in viewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement sticky-promo; screenshot shows only the bottom promo bar and no visible button; styles.css places add-to-cart at bottom:16px with z-index:10 while sticky-promo is bottom:0, height:84px, z-index:20.
repair.rationale: Moving the button to 100px from the bottom clears the 84px promo plus a 16px gap, preserving both elements while making the button hit-testable.

repair.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the canonical catalog price for nova-sneaker
repair.evidenceSummary: Screenshot and catalog show displayed price $89.00 (8900 minor), but probes show cart total 7900 after 1 item and 15800 after 2 items, i.e. 7900 per item, contradicting catalog priceMinor 8900
repair.rationale: Use product.priceMinor loaded from window.CATALOG as the single source of truth for cart totals, without hardcoding the catalog value
